title: mdkit - Your markdown files, everywhere.
excerpt: mdkit is a menu bar app for managing skill.md files you use with AI tools. Store skills in the cloud, version them, and share with your team.
content_html:
Beta — Available for macOS and Windows

Dropbox but for the AI era.

Your personal library of reusable AI workflows. mdkit keeps your skill.md files organized, synced, and ready to use. Manage versions, access everything from your menu bar, and share with your team.

Built for the .md files you get from ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, and other AI tools.

Download for Free
